review_mode: Read-only source comparison and AST validation. Helper was not imported or executed. No browser, original /app, production API, DB, GitHub or repository mutation.

expected_identity.deployment_sha: Required CLI input: complete lowercase 40-character merge SHA; not guessed.
expected_identity.actor: Required safe CLI input, checked against the fresh active lease.

checks.name: private_evidence_and_no_repeat
checks.evidence: Requires an existing owned/private non-symlink /tmp/mezan-pr1918-original-* directory; rejects any 28-verify* file before main. Child stdout/stderr use exclusive xb creation, and there is exactly one verify invocation.

checks.name: actual_build_and_identity
checks.evidence: Requires outcome.json build/ready/source/M/release/untracked_count=120/lease_created=False and actual integer 0 exit with no problem in 22-build.result.json before any guard command.

checks.name: fresh_owned_lease
checks.evidence: First official status must be active=True and match actor, A, M, R and protocol 5. No prepare, prepublish, abort or manual lease-clear command exists in helper.

checks.name: actual_exit_before_parse
checks.evidence: Waits for child, flushes/fsyncs raw stdout/stderr, atomically saves result with actual_exit/timing/problem, then rejects nonzero and only then parses JSON.

checks.name: no_overall_verify_timeout
checks.evidence: child timeout defaults to None; verify call has no timeout keyword. Only the two bounded status commands use 15 seconds.

checks.name: three_probes_and_frontend
checks.evidence: Requires verified=True, exact integer checks=3, A/M/R/protocol/url identity, nonempty frontend_checked_requests and frontend artifact tree equal to prepared lease. Inspected official guard runs health plus frontend verification in each of three observations.

checks.name: safe_official_lease_completion
checks.evidence: Helper delegates successful completion only to official verifier. That verifier holds the release mutex and rereads/fences the exact observed lease before its own removal; helper never directly removes a lease.

checks.name: fresh_final_inactive
checks.evidence: After verify succeeds and identities match, a new official status must have active is False and no incomplete lease directory before verified summary is written.

checks.name: source_and_evidence_safety
checks.evidence: Helper has no source/build mutation or financial action. Child runs existing original /app guard with -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Writes are confined to private evidence; successful official verifier performs its prescribed lease close.

operator_requirements: Run only after explicit successful platform publication of this release.
Supply the reviewed merge SHA, exact lease actor, and actual successful rehearsal evidence directory.
The script uses the rehearsal preservation evidence; it does not independently hash current untracked files or inspect unsaved UI buffers.
The local review does not assert current /app, lease, build, publication or public-health state.
timestamp_policy: No execution or original-host observation is claimed.
